title: scope OBSERVABILITY.md to generated target-project code — stop per-ticket relitigation in reviews (human ruling 2026-07-07)
description: Human ruling at the 2026-07-07 Gate 5 checkpoint (option: scope to generated projects). Context: .claude/shared/OBSERVABILITY.md mandates OTel spans, but the hivemind repo itself carries zero OpenTelemetry dependencies or instrumentation anywhere, and the standard references manifests (SCREEN_SPECS.md, BLOCK_TASKS.md) that exist only in the vendored Spine skill flow for scaffolded target projects. Three consecutive reviewers (rev-103, rev-104, rev-105) independently flagged and then hand-waived the mismatch as a repo-wide standing deviation. Fix is documentation: state the standard's scope explicitly so reviewers stop relitigating it per ticket.
acceptance_criteria: OBSERVABILITY.md gains an explicit scope statement: it governs code the framework GENERATES for target projects (the impl-* manifest/code-writer flow), NOT the framework's own repo, whose observability convention is structured JSON result envelopes + typed errors with codes.
The reviewer guidance (agents/reviewer.md + parity copy, or wherever the observability gate is invoked) references the scope so the per-ticket judgment is mechanical.
UAT: read the amended standard and one reviewer-guidance site; confirm the scope is unambiguous.
